sql: WITH december AS (SELECT s.* FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries n ON n.country_id=c.country_id WHERE n.country_name='Italy' AND t.calendar_year=2021 AND t.calendar_month_number=12),lines AS (SELECT d.*,k.unit_cost,k.unit_price,d.amount_sold-d.quantity_sold*k.unit_cost line_profit,d.quantity_sold*(k.unit_price-k.unit_cost) list_profit FROM december d LEFT JOIN costs k ON k.prod_id=d.prod_id AND k.time_id=d.time_id AND k.channel_id=d.channel_id AND k.promo_id=d.promo_id),customer_profit AS (SELECT cust_id,SUM(line_profit) profit,SUM(list_profit) profit_by_list_price,COUNT(*) sale_rows FROM lines GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT COUNT(*) sale_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) active_customers,SUM(unit_cost IS NULL) missing_cost,MIN(amount_sold-quantity_sold*unit_price) min_revenue_delta,MAX(amount_sold-quantity_sold*unit_price) max_revenue_delta,SUM(line_profit) actual_profit,SUM(list_profit) list_profit FROM lines
